clips.title: The story
paras: Tome of Divinity is a summons directed at developing human paladins visiting Ironforge. Master Brandur Ironhammer bids initiates make the journey south to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, where Master Duthorian Rall oversees advanced training in the sacred Tomes of Divinity.

While dwarven paladins train vigorously within Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, the broader traditions of the Silver Hand remain deeply entwined with the Church of the Holy Light in human lands. Word sent north from Stormwind calls on promising holy warriors to present themselves directly before the senior priesthood and paladin mentors of the Cathedral of Light.

Master Brandur Ironhammer recognizes when a student has progressed far enough to step into the deeper mysteries of the faith. Journeying south—whether by the subterranean Deeprun Tram or across the mountain passes—brings initiates to Stormwind's Cathedral District, where Duthorian Rall prepares them to study the sacred Tomes and master the rites of redemption.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sorry to interrupt your travels, traveler, but I thought you should know that word was sent from Stormwind recently asking that paladins report there for training.
If I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.
Look for Duthorian Rall in Stormwind. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the Cathedral of Light, adventurer.
